svg.text: One external CLK_IN; six static 10-bit tuning words; real launch/RUN/reset storage and buffered clock, drain and valid paths.
EVAL = TAP_A and not TAP_D; CAPTURE = TAP_B and not TAP_C; PHASE = TAP_E and not TAP_F; all require buffered VALID.
The SR output drives local buffer inputs; the real valid driver supplies the remote window network. Stop, drain, configure, settle, restart.
